title: MV Is there a place to request Tutorial s?

posts.author: firestalker
posts.body:
I'm looking for a tutorial on how to incorporate your own animation into existing DragonBone Characters and implement them, so they work with RPG Maker MV/MZ.
I've tried several times to do this and I have been met with an error every time when I playtest my game. I would be nice if there was tutorial on how to do this and possibly information on what motions are allowed or not?
I'm a novice when it comes this DragonBones stuff... But given a little direction and guidance I can usually get it down.

posts.author: firestalker
posts.body: Bump - Maybe someone can just tell me if there is a certain version of the DragonBones Program I would use? I think the most recent version is too high for the DragonBones Plugin... Maybe?

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
So, for the dragon bones animation itself, I assume you're using a program to animate it?
IF s,o you could check to see if there is a forum or Discord server for that specific one you're using.
But when you said you run into errors, is it when you try to do a test run on RPG Maker?
If so, then you could post on here inquring about the error if it's to do with the maker itself.

Thank you for the reply...  I actually found the fix the error JUST THIS MORNING... When I saved the SKE and TEX files I wasn't setting the version properly. The Error I was getting was "Incompatible Data Version". I had to change the Data Version from 5.6 to 5.0.
I'm embarrassed it took me so long to figure that out.
